statement: Lambda lists reserved 1-Click Cluster pricing for NVIDIA HGX B200 at $9.86 per GPU-hour for a 16-GPU cluster on a two-week-to-one-year term.
why: Published neocloud rental levels are the visible clearing price for current-generation accelerator capacity, but this page gives no prior level or change, so it is a static level only.

impact.mechanism: Listed rental rate is a display overlay on merchant-GPU cloud economics; with no stated baseline it carries no directional signal.

confidence.basis: First-party vendor price page, but secondary tier and a single publisher with no historical comparison.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 3.99 -> 9.86 (tol 1%); sources: lambda.ai
